name: CIBC Aventura Visa Infinite Privilege Card

localized_names.en: CIBC Aventura Visa Infinite Privilege Card

apr.notes: 21.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash (cash advances, balance transfers and CIBC Convenience Cheques) for non-Quebec residents, 21.99% for Quebec residents.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 1.25 Aventura Point(s) per $1 on all other purchases.

categories.label: Travel booked through the CIBC Rewards Centre
Dining, entertainment, transportation, gas, EV charging and groceries

rewards.redemption_notes: Aventura Points redeem for flights, hotel stays, vacation packages and car rentals, and to pay off eligible card purchases.

notes: Network tier is Visa Infinite Privilege per the card name. Bonus earn rates apply on the first $200,000 in net annual card purchases on the account.
